name: Fody Foods Low-FODMAP Classic BBQ Sauce (Sweet & Smoky)
whyItWorks: Formulated without onion or garlic fructans. Sweetened with cane sugar and organic blackstrap molasses with natural smoke flavor. Delivers authentic pit BBQ flavor without gastrointestinal colic.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Brush onto grilled chicken breast, pulled pork, or ground turkey crumbles.
watchOuts: Gentle and non-bloating; safe for active disease and recovery.
